headline: Updates on Blackburn Park tenants, Cape Ann Industrial Park, and the Jodrey State Fish Pier, plus an EDIC bond discussion.
summary: The October tenants meeting at Blackburn Park will be recapped, with next steps. Other items cover workforce training, waste services, and Mass Save, plus the website and financials.
